id: 03_EquiTips IC Biomedical Lab Dewars & Liquid Nitrogen Storage Explained
title: 液氮杜瓦罐的安全使用
source_doc: course/Industrial Gas & Cryogenic Equipment/03_EquiTips IC Biomedical Lab Dewars & Liquid Nitrogen Storage Explained.md
author_source: project/Industrial Gas & Cryogenic Equipment/03_EquiTips IC Biomedical Lab Dewars & Liquid Nitrogen Storage Explained/src.py

points.K3: 出液嘴让液氮平稳流出
points.S2: 液氮会窒息：通风和氧含量报警
points.S4: 盖子、阀门和压力附件不乱动

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一排大小不同的银色液氮罐旁，罐口冒着白雾，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a row of silver liquid nitrogen dewars of different sizes, white mist curling from one neck, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲液氮杜瓦罐的安全使用。
overlay: 液氮杜瓦罐的安全使用

shots.scene: 雪花、氧气下降、密闭瓶爆裂三个警示图标
shots.prompt_en: Three warning icons: a snowflake for frostbite, an O2 symbol with a down arrow, and a sealed bottle bursting. No people.
shots.narration: 冻伤、窒息、超压，是液氮的三大危险。

shots.scene: 阿杰空手抱着一个小液氮罐，准备往一个带螺旋盖的保温杯里倒
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, bare-handed with no goggles, tilts a small dewar toward a screw-cap thermos bottle on the bench.
shots.narration: 阿杰想把液氮倒进保温杯带回去用。

shots.scene: 带螺旋盖的保温杯里冒白雾的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a screw-cap thermos bottle with mist inside, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 盖紧的保温杯，可能会被胀破！

shots.scene: 小研戴着防冻手套和护目镜，拦住阿杰
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing cryogenic gloves and safety goggles, stops the young male student.
shots.narration: 小研拦住他：先穿戴好，用对容器。

shots.scene: 实验室角落里的液氮罐，旁边是装着样品架的储存罐
shots.prompt_en: A laboratory corner with a liquid nitrogen dewar and a sample storage tank with racks inside. No people.
shots.narration: 液氮杜瓦罐用来储存和转运液氮。

shots.scene: 装在罐口的取液器：压力表、阀门、长取液管
shots.prompt_en: A liquid withdrawal device mounted on a dewar neck: a blank pressure gauge, a small valve and a long dip tube. No people.
shots.narration: 取液器装在罐口，把液氮引出来。

shots.scene: 从小到大一排液氮罐图标
shots.prompt_en: A row of dewar icons from small to large, each with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 液氮罐有大有小，按用量来选。

shots.scene: 小罐放在台面，大罐放在带轮底座上
shots.prompt_en: A small dewar on a bench and a large dewar on a wheeled base on the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 大罐要配带轮底座，方便又稳当。

shots.section_title: 出液嘴让液氮平稳流出
shots.scene: 出液嘴特写，液氮平稳流进一个敞口杜瓦杯
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a withdrawal spout with a phase separator, liquid nitrogen flowing smoothly into an open-mouth dewar flask. No people.
shots.narration: 出液嘴带相分离器，液氮流得平稳。
overlay: 出液嘴让液氮平稳流出

shots.section_title: 出液嘴让液氮平稳流出
shots.scene: 没有分离器时液氮四处飞溅的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of liquid nitrogen spraying and splashing from a bare pipe end, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 减少飞溅，也就减少冻伤。

shots.scene: 老李把软管接到取液器接口上，给液氮罐充装
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer, wearing cryogenic gloves and a face shield, connects a hose to the withdrawal device port to fill a dewar.
shots.narration: 充装时，经接口接软管就能灌。

shots.scene: 取液器被反复拆下的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a withdrawal device being pulled out of a cold dewar again and again, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 少拆装冷部件，更快、更安全。

shots.scene: 取液器零件磨损示意，旁边是打勾的完整零件
shots.prompt_en: A worn seal icon next to an intact seal icon with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 还能减少零件磨损和泄漏。

shots.scene: 工厂里一排银色罐体在生产线上
shots.prompt_en: A row of shiny silver dewar shells on a factory production line. No people.
shots.narration: 储罐要由专业工厂制造、检验。

shots.scene: 老周和阿杰核对一张空白采购单
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the young male student check a blank purchase form together.
shots.narration: 从正规渠道采购，资料证明要齐全。

shots.scene: 液氮滴在手背上的图标，旁边是雪花
shots.prompt_en: An icon of liquid nitrogen drops falling on a bare hand with a snowflake symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 液氮极冷，碰到皮肤会严重冻伤。

shots.scene: 小研穿实验服，戴防冻手套和面屏
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wears a lab coat, loose cryogenic gloves and a full face shield, ready to dispense liquid nitrogen.
shots.narration: 取液、充装要戴防冻手套和面屏。

shots.scene: 长裤、不露脚面的鞋图标打勾，凉鞋打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons: long trousers and closed shoes with a green check, sandals crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 穿长裤和不露脚面的鞋。

shots.scene: 小研慢慢把液氮倒入敞口杜瓦杯
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student slowly pours liquid nitrogen into an open dewar flask, keeping her face away.
shots.narration: 慢慢倒，脸别凑近罐口。

shots.scene: 冻伤的手在常温流水下冲洗，旁边红十字
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand under gently running lukewarm water next to a red cross icon. No people.
shots.narration: 万一冻伤，别揉搓，及时就医。

shots.section_title: 液氮会窒息：通风和氧含量报警
shots.scene: 液氮罐冒出的白雾铺满小房间地面
shots.prompt_en: White cold vapor from a dewar spreads across the floor of a small room. No people.
shots.narration: 液氮汽化，会把空气里的氧挤走。
overlay: 液氮会窒息：通风和氧含量报警

shots.section_title: 液氮会窒息：通风和氧含量报警
shots.scene: 墙上的氧含量报警器和排风口
shots.prompt_en: An oxygen level alarm on the wall beside an exhaust vent with a running fan. No people.
shots.narration: 存放房间要通风，装氧含量报警。

shots.section_title: 液氮会窒息：通风和氧含量报警
shots.scene: 小研进门前看一眼报警器绿灯
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks the green light on the oxygen alarm before entering the dewar room.
shots.narration: 进门前，先看报警器是否正常。

shots.section_title: 液氮会窒息：通风和氧含量报警
shots.scene: 关着门的小隔间、车厢里放着液氮罐的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a dewar inside a closed small closet and inside a car trunk, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不在密闭小空间里放液氮。

shots.scene: 螺旋盖瓶子里液氮汽化、瓶子胀裂的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a tightly capped bottle with liquid nitrogen boiling inside, the bottle bulging and cracking. No people.
shots.narration: 液氮装进密闭容器，会胀破伤人。

shots.scene: 保温杯、带盖试剂瓶、塑料瓶三个图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a screw-cap thermos, a capped reagent bottle and a plastic bottle, all crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 保温杯、塑料瓶都不能装液氮。

shots.scene: 敞口杜瓦杯打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: An open-mouth dewar flask with a loose cap and a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 只用专用的液氮容器。

shots.section_title: 盖子、阀门和压力附件不乱动
shots.scene: 液氮罐口放着配套的透气盖
shots.prompt_en: A dewar with its matching vented neck plug resting loosely on top. No people.
shots.narration: 罐口只用配套的透气盖。
overlay: 盖子、阀门和压力附件不乱动

shots.section_title: 盖子、阀门和压力附件不乱动
shots.scene: 用胶带缠死罐口的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a dewar neck sealed shut with tape and a rubber stopper, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能塞死、缠死罐口。

shots.section_title: 盖子、阀门和压力附件不乱动
shots.scene: 安全阀和压力表图标，一只扳手被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a safety relief valve and a blank pressure gauge, with a wrench crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 安全阀、压力表不得自行拆改。

shots.section_title: 盖子、阀门和压力附件不乱动
shots.scene: 扳手拧带压接头的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a wrench loosening a fitting on a frosty pressurized line, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 罐内有压力时，不拆接头和取液器。

shots.scene: 老李推着带轮底座上的液氮罐慢慢走
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer slowly pushes a large dewar on a wheeled base along a corridor.
shots.narration: 搬运要慢、要稳，防止倾倒。

shots.scene: 电梯里人和液氮罐在一起的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person standing in an elevator together with a dewar, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 液氮罐不与人同乘电梯。

shots.scene: 房间里一个人倒地，另一个人要冲进门的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person collapsed inside a dewar room and another person rushing in, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 有人晕倒在里面，不要冲进去。

shots.scene: 电话图标旁有火焰和红十字
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a fire icon and a red cross icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 立即拨打119、120，报告负责人。

shots.scene: 排风扇开启，戴呼吸器的救援人员图标
shots.prompt_en: An exhaust fan running and an icon of a rescuer wearing a breathing apparatus. No people.
shots.narration: 开门通风，等有呼吸防护的人施救。

shots.scene: 王老师在空白屏幕前讲解，屏幕上是储罐和气瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator explains in front of a blank screen showing icons of a pressure tank and a gas cylinder.
shots.narration: 带压储罐属于压力容器管理范围。

shots.scene: 王老师给学生发空白培训证书
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands blank training certificates to the female graduate student and the young male student.
shots.narration: 经过培训再使用，以现行规定为准。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现手套、面屏、敞口杯图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of cryogenic gloves, a face shield and an open dewar flask.
shots.narration: 戴好防护，只用专用敞口容器。

shots.scene: 氧含量报警器和排风扇打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an oxygen alarm and an exhaust fan with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 房间通风，氧含量报警要正常。

shots.scene: 透气盖、安全阀、带轮底座三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a vented neck plug, a safety relief valve and a wheeled dewar base. No people.
shots.narration: 透气盖不塞死，附件不乱动，稳着搬。

shots.scene: 电话和出口图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a telephone and an exit door. No people.
shots.narration: 有人晕倒不硬闯，拨打119、120。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在整齐的液氮罐旁挥手道别，戴着防冻手套
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, wearing cryogenic gloves, waves goodbye beside a tidy row of dewars.
shots.narration: 冷静对待液氮，安全实验，下次见！
